problem_statement: A new nanocoap cache module must be available as net/nanocoap/cache.h and provide nanocoap_cache_init(), nanocoap_cache_used_count(), nanocoap_cache_free_count(), nanocoap_cache_add_by_req(), nanocoap_cache_key_lookup(), nanocoap_cache_del(), nanocoap_cache_key_generate(), and nanocoap_cache_key_compare(). nanocoap_cache_key_generate() must produce a cache key from a request's CoAP options such that requests with the same options produce equal keys, while requests with different options produce keys that nanocoap_cache_key_compare() reports unequal. nanocoap_cache_add_by_req() stores a response associated with a request and returns a nanocoap_cache_entry_t containing at least the cache_key and max_age fields; nanocoap_cache_key_lookup() returns the matching entry, and nanocoap_cache_del() removes it. The cache must hold CONFIG_NANOCOAP_CACHE_ENTRIES entries; used_count and free_count must reflect additions and deletions, and when full it must replace entries so that a recently accessed entry can survive later insertions. The max_age of a stored response must be the current time plus the response's COAP_OPT_MAX_AGE value when present, otherwise the current time plus 60 seconds. The test also uses CONFIG_NANOCOAP_CACHE_RESPONSE_SIZE as a response length.
